narr: Heavy rain from a cluster of storms caused street flooding across portions of Harris, Brazoria, and Fort Bend Counties during the afternoon of May 14.
ev: Several areas were flooded across NE Harris County, including FM529 and Hwy 290, Roberts Cemetery Rd, Mesquite River Trl at Old Windmill Trl, and 249 at Killough St.
Water over the roadways around Canal and 66th St made streets impassable.
The Mt. Moriah Rd Bridge was closed due to high water as a result of flooding rain.
